newsitem.title: USA: Andal Corp in talks to sell main unit.
newsitem.headline: Andal Corp in talks to sell main unit.

text.p: Andal Corp said on Friday that it is presently in discussion with a larger company for the sale of its principal operating subsidiary, Multi-Arc Inc.
Abdal said that no agreement has been reached on either price or structure of any transaction and that there can be no assurance that these discussions will result in any transaction.
Andal, through its Multi-Arc subsidiary, is engaged in surface enhancement as a leading provider of thin-film metal coating services and systems.
